description: Make a link where the person drops an .ipa, .apk or .aab (on Pro and Team also a desktop build: .dmg, .pkg, zipped .app, .msix, .msixbundle, .appx, .appxbundle or .msi) in a browser, for chat assistants that cannot read files on their computer. The link works once, for 30 minutes, on any device, without signing in; the build goes into this workspace as the person who connected, with the plan's limits. Give the person the url, then call check_upload with the ticket for the install link and store readiness. Optional release notes and a channel. Pro and Team, Developer role.

channel.description: Put the build into this channel (such as beta) when it is ready

name: create_upload_link
title: Make a one time upload link
